product_name: Bajaj Life Invest Protect Goal III
regulatory_descriptor: A Unit-Linked, Non-Participating, Individual Life Insurance Savings Plan
key_benefits: Death Benefit: higher of Prevailing Sum Assured or Regular Premium Fund Value, plus higher of Top-up Fund Value or Top-up Sum Assured; subject to a minimum Guaranteed Benefit of 105% of total premiums (incl. top-ups) received to date of death
Maturity Benefit: Total Fund Value as on the maturity date (market-linked)
Loyalty Advantage: Return of Premium Allocation Charge (ROAC) at end of 15th year and Return of Mortality Charge (ROMC)
Loyalty Addition: percentage of average of previous three years' daily Regular Premium Fund Value added to fund
Fund Maintenance Booster (FMB): from 4th policy year, tops up Fund Value to one Annualized Premium if it falls below that level
Family Benefit: 1% of average of previous three years' daily Regular Premium Fund Value for existing-customer families, paid at maturity
Market-linked growth across multiple funds and portfolio strategies; partial withdrawals allowed after the 5-year lock-in
riders_available: Bajaj Life Linked Accident Protection Rider II (UIN 116A057V02)
Bajaj Life Linked New Critical Illness Benefit Rider (UIN 116A060V01)

key_terms.free_look_note: 30 days from the date of receipt of the policy document.
key_terms.grace_period: 30 days for yearly, half-yearly and quarterly premium frequencies; 15 days for monthly frequency.
key_terms.suicide_clause: On death due to suicide within 12 months from the Date of Commencement or latest revival (whichever is later), the nominee/beneficiary is entitled to the Total Fund Value available on the date of intimation of death; any charges other than Fund Management Charges recovered after the date of death are added back. No other exclusion applies w.r.t. death.
key_terms.lock_in_note: Five-year lock-in: on surrender during the first 5 policy years only the Discontinuance Value is payable as Surrender Value at the end of the lock-in period; partial withdrawals allowed only from the 6th policy year onward.
key_terms.guaranteed_benefit_note: Total death benefit is subject to a minimum Guaranteed Benefit of 105% of total premiums (including top-ups) received to date of death — this is the only guaranteed element; maturity value is market-linked Fund Value.
key_terms.sum_assured_reduction_note: Sum Assured is reduced to the extent of partial withdrawals made from the Regular Premium Fund during the 2 years immediately preceding the date of death.
key_terms.tax_note: Tax benefit as per applicable laws; GST applicable as per prevailing Tax Laws, subject to amendment.

claims_marketing_must_support: Any '105% guaranteed' / 'guaranteed benefit' claim is bounded ONLY to the minimum death benefit (105% of total premiums) — it does not guarantee maturity value or returns.
Maturity Benefit equals the Total Fund Value (market-linked), not a guaranteed maturity amount.
Any death-benefit claim must reflect that the Sum Assured is reduced by partial withdrawals made in the 2 years before death.
Loyalty Advantage / ROAC / ROMC / FMB are charge-return and fund-maintenance features, conditional on the policy being in-force and premiums paid up — not unconditional payouts.
claims_marketing_must_avoid: Do NOT use 'guaranteed returns' / 'assured returns' / 'risk-free' language — this is a Unit-Linked plan and investment risk is borne entirely by the policyholder.
Do NOT use 'bonus' language — the plan is non-participating; Loyalty Additions and charge-returns are not bonuses.
Do NOT present illustrative market-linked return figures as guaranteed or as upper/lower limits of returns.
Do NOT imply liquidity in the first five years — funds are locked in and partial withdrawal is only available from the 6th policy year.
Do NOT position fund-value growth as guaranteed; only the 105%-of-premiums minimum death benefit is guaranteed.
must_state: Full regulatory descriptor (Unit-Linked, Non-Participating, Individual Life Insurance Savings Plan)
ULIP market-risk disclosure: investment in ULIPs is subject to capital-market risks and the policyholder is solely responsible for his/her investment decisions
Standard disclaimer to read the policy document / benefit illustration for full terms, charges and exclusions
